new_company.name: New company
new_company.description: Founded this year or last year.
new_company.tip: {{firma}} is a young company: ask how they keep their books now and what they want sorted from the start.

revenue_growth.name: Growing turnover
revenue_growth.description: Turnover is up more than 20% on the year before.
revenue_growth.tip: {{firma}} grew turnover by {{crestere_ca}}%. Start from what gets harder as they grow.

target_caen.name: Target industry
target_caen.description: The CAEN code is in the target list. Fill in the list in the filters.
target_caen.tip: Their activity ({{caen}}) is one we know. Give an example from the field.

engaged.name: Engaged with messages
engaged.description: Opened or replied to an email we sent.
engaged.tip: {{firma}} has already read our message. Call with a reference to it.

not_contacted.name: Not contacted in 30 days
not_contacted.description: No activity on the prospect in the last 30 days, or ever.
not_contacted.tip: We have not talked to {{firma}} in a while. Pick up from the last conversation, if there is one.

decision_maker.name: Has a decision maker
decision_maker.description: A person is marked as the decision maker.
decision_maker.tip: At {{firma}} we know who decides. Ask for them directly.
